rows.original_queue_acceptance: Planning/coordination skills consult latest resume state and relevant findings before reconstructing work; classify adopt/defer/reject/supersede; prefer canonical amend/rescope/handoff; avoid duplicate successors. Add structured assignment category, bounded labels/tags, one primary role plus optional supporting roles, and expose them to routing, filtering, checkpoints and skill selection without changing authorization. Worker messages classify FYI/request/blocker/decision/handoff/scope-change, cite exact assignment/branch/PR/evidence identity, state impact/requested action, and reconcile against canonical state before acting. Consume the canonical 1.9.4 staff identities instead of recreating names. Add Julian-managed relationship context per sticky staff identity from explicit feedback/repeated collaboration patterns; no autonomous relationship engine, hidden affinity scores, inferred sensitive traits or canned jokes. Worker communication resolves approved sticky staff names while preserving canonical machine IDs underneath; unbound workers keep machine identity. Human-facing narration is organization-first and executive by default: lead with plain-language health/outcome, who is handling it, and what happens next. Keep branch names, SHAs, schema/runtime versions, namespaces, transport mechanics and tool internals out of ordinary chat/status unless they explain a blocker/failure, are needed for a concrete QA decision, or the user asks for technical detail. Preserve exact machine evidence underneath for traceability. Live amendment delivery: active workers/chats maintain a monotonic amendment cursor and perform a bounded relevant-change check at synchronization points such as start/resume, before major source mutations or commit/PR/deploy transitions, after external waits, and on the normal heartbeat cadence. No-change checks add no model context. New amendments are classified informational, plan-adjusting, scope-changing or blocking; informational/plan-adjusting changes merge into the next safe step, while scope-changing/blocking changes force canonical reconciliation before further conflicting work. Expose exact consumed revision so resumes and handoffs know what instructions the worker has seen. Stall recovery: add a caught-up/self-recovery skill plus Relay-side no-progress detection. Worker-side recovery detects repeated/no-op actions, stale heartbeat with no external wait, unchanged canonical progress across expected transition points, repeated identical tool failures, or circular replanning; it reconstructs from the latest valid resume checkpoint + canonical assignment/source/PR/deploy state, identifies the last successful action and precise stall point, emits a concise "caught up here" status, and resumes from the next safe action without user prompting. Relay-side detection records a bounded recovery signal/checkpoint when observed progress stalls so an active/resumed chat can consume it through live amendment/instruction sync. Do not self-recover through genuine external waits, unresolved authorization/tool-schema/client failures, destructive ambiguity, or scope conflicts; those surface as explicit blockers. Limit retries and prevent recovery loops. Communication-skill implementation: ship a first-class Relay executive communication skill, not just prose policy. The skill defines a two-layer output contract: a compact human layer with health/outcome, responsible staff, what changed and next step; and subordinate technical_evidence carrying exact branches/SHAs/schema/runtime/tool identities for traceability. Ordinary chat/status must render from the human layer first. Add result-shaping helpers/contracts so Relay tools can expose presentation-ready summary fields separately from machine evidence, and evals that transform technical fixture outputs into plain-language staff-aware updates while preserving blockers/QA-critical detail. The skill may guide tone/presentation but never alter technical truth or authorization.
